data.fund_name: Motilal Oswal Nifty Microcap 250 Index Fund
data.fund_type: An open-ended fund replicating / tracking the Nifty Microcap 250 Total Return Index
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to provide returns that, before expenses, correspond to the total returns of the securities as represented by Nifty Microcap 250 Total Return Index, subject to tracking error. However, there can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme would be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Constituents of Nifty Microcap 250 Index  95% - 100%, Units of liquid schemes and/or money market instruments  0%-5%
